## Orchestrator model (Cursor)

Preferred session model for this command: `composer-2.5` (tier `cheap` via `home/agents/model-map.yaml`). Cursor slash commands inherit the chat model — switch the model picker to that pin before invoking if the session is on a stronger tier. Subagents keep their own frontmatter pins.

## Arguments (Cursor)

Positional args from the slash invocation: `$1`, `$2`, `$3`, … .
When this prompt mentions `$ARGUMENTS`, treat it as the joined remainder
`"$1 $2 $3 …"` (trim; empty if no args). Multi-token parsers (e.g. `/dispatch`)
still apply: `$1` = first token (key), later tokens / flags as documented below.


Triage **push-time** security findings on open PRs. This is the security inbox
named in agent-routing — not local `/review-bugbot` / `/review-security` (those
review a local diff before/without a PR).

Do **not** investigate or fix in this parent turn beyond routing. Do **not**
reopen the PR-opening gate.

## Allowlist (gather only these)

Authors / check contexts matching:

- Bugbot / Cursor Bugbot
- security-guidance (or similarly named security-review bots)
- Dependabot **security** (not routine version bumps)
- GitHub code scanning / CodeQL

Exclude CodeRabbit and other style/nit bots — those stay on babysit’s pick-list
or `/address-reviews`.

## 1. Gather (fan out to `scout`)

Spawn `scout` to list unresolved allowlisted findings on my open PRs (or the
`$ARGUMENTS` gh scope). Prefer `gh api` / `gh pr view` / check annotations —
compact rows only: `repo#pr`, bot, one-line summary, thread/check id, URL.

If the gather is empty, say so and stop — no ping.

## 2. Classify

Spawn **`security-triage`** (cheap) with the compact gather. Require its
terminal line (`ADVANCE → parent` or `HALT:`). On `HALT`, surface and stop.

## 3. Present + apply (gated)

Show a numbered plan from the agent’s table:

- `babysit` → `/babysit-pr <n>`
- `ignore` → drop (note why)
- `needs you` → list only; do not auto-act

Under mode A, **STOP for `go`** before dispatching any `babysit` rows. Then
dispatch selected `babysit` items (parallel ok).

## 4. Signal egress

When you park or present a **non-empty** triage result (any finding classified,
including `needs you` / `ignore`), run:

```bash
"$HOME/.config/herdr/scripts/signal_egress.sh" triage "<one-line summary, e.g. 3 findings on 2 PRs>"
```

Skip the ping only when gather was empty. On orchestrator `HALT:` during this
command, also run `signal_egress.sh halt "<reason>"` per HANDOFF.

End with what you routed and what still needs the human.
